description: Laboratory experiments are based upon the corresponding theory course EEPC-303. An updated list of experiments is floated by the course coordinator before the beginning of each semester.
outcomes: Design the controller parameters for different systems.
Describe the performance of feedback controllers.
Analyse the stability of non-linear systems.
Understand the feedback controller for control operations.
experiments: Study the model of a magnetic levitation system and design and implement a controller for stabilization.
Study the model of a twin rotor aerodynamic system and design a controller to control its pitch and yaw angles.
Design and implement a state feedback controller for a rotary flexible link.
Analyze the performance of a single rotary inverted pendulum by applying a feedback controller and determine closed-loop stability under uncertainty.
Analyze the stability of nonlinear systems with nonlinearities (relay, dead-zone, hysteresis) using phase plane analysis and the describing function method.
Analyze the performance of a double rotary inverted pendulum by applying a feedback controller.
Study a microcontroller kit with interfacing to an ADC and a stepper motor.
Design a feedback controller for reducing the vibrations in a torsional system.
Design a controller for level and flow control in a coupled-tank system.
